title: stepdoc run record
description: One run of one or more test cases. The procedure renders the symbolic fields, the executed report the concrete ones. Times are seconds since the test case started.

schema_version.description: 0.2 adds count, t_last, section and reads; 0.3 adds symbolic_text, param_info and vector; 0.4 adds repeat entries, check note, label, operands, each and index; 0.5 adds the test's doc, the precondition section and applied_in; 0.6 adds a check's branches

section.description: Unscoped entries only: the phase they ran in (STEP-8)

id.description: pytest node id of the case, e.g. tests/test_api.py::test_user[ana]

procedure_id.description: Cases with the same procedure_id share one procedure (the node id without the parameter id)

status.description: Combined from the recorded steps and checks

seed.description: Random seed when a source provides one (PAR-4)

unscoped.description: Actions, checks and repeats outside any step (ACT-3); each carries the section it ran in

param_info.description: Parameter descriptions from an adapter (PAR-3), by parameter name

doc.description: The test function's docstring (DOC-1), only when it has text. Each value is a section as written, dedented: list markers and backticks kept

description.description: Text before the first heading: summary and paragraphs

acceptance.description: The Acceptance criteria: (or Pass criteria:) section

vector.description: The generated row this case runs, when an adapter knows it

number.description: 1, 1.2, 1.2.3; pre-conditions P1, P1.1; setup steps S1, S1.1; teardown steps T1

note.description: From step(..., note=...): why, or what the reader should know

loop.description: A step made by a titled stepdoc.repeat(): its entries are one pass (ACT-10)

counter.description: From repeat(..., counter=...): the variable that counts the passes

inc.description: From repeat(..., inc=...): how much the counter grows each pass

section.description: precondition: a stepdoc.precondition() block (PRE-1), in whichever phase it ran; the others are the phase the step ran in (STEP-8)

applied_in.description: On a pre-condition this test did not apply itself (PRE-3): the id of the test in which a shared fixture applied it. The step then has no entries and the status it got there

entries.description: Actions, checks, repeats and child steps in execution order, sharing one numbering

repeat.description: Passes of a loop that did the same thing each time, shown once (ACT-10)

until.description: Exit condition in words, from stepdoc.repeat(until=...)

note.description: From stepdoc.repeat(..., note=...): why, or what the reader should know

counter.description: From repeat(..., counter=...): the variable that counts the passes

inc.description: From repeat(..., inc=...): how much the counter grows each pass

count.description: Passes; null when a repeat() block's passes could not be told apart

t_last.description: Time of the last action of the last pass

entries.description: One pass, with the values of the last one

op.description: Free-form: request, read, write, query, measure, ...

direction.description: in: the test sends value; out: value is a result; exchange: value is sent, the response is in meta

concrete.description: JSON value; non-JSON values are tagged objects with $type plus $repr, $enum or $base64

bound_to.description: Name a result was assigned to

resolved.description: false when the source could not be found (SYM-5)

count.description: Identical consecutive events from one code location collapsed into this entry (ACT-4 polling)

t_last.description: Time of the last repeated event when count > 1

meta.description: Bridge metadata, for example the HTTP status code

text.description: What is verified, e.g. the assert expression

selected.description: Chosen branch of a composite check

reads.description: Reads on the check's source line that fed it (ACT-5)

symbolic_text.description: Text for the procedure when it differs from text (an adapter's check with a symbolic expected value or checked register)

note.description: Words for the reader, shown after the check's text in parentheses: the producer's note=, else a source comment (CHK-9)

label.description: The name given to the check, when text and symbolic_text start with it in quotes ('<label>': <code> or '<label>' <code>): renderers show it as words and the rest as code

operands.description: Names the test gave the compared values (pytest-verifier's actual_name= and expected_name=); they word text (concrete; the expected name as the producer's description shows it) and symbolic_text (symbolic), each as one line

each.description: One check per item folded into one line (CHK-11, pytest-verifier's all_satisfy): text reads 'for each <item> in <items>, <code>' and children hold only the items that failed

item.description: How the test names one item (the factory's parameter)

items.description: How the test names the collection (source text)

values.description: The value each item's check got, in item order; when count is over 64, the first 32 and the last 32

index.description: For a child of a folded check (each): the item's position, from 0

branches.description: A guarded check's if/elif/else chain (CHK-12, pytest-verifier's guard), in order, the default last

label.description: The name the test gave the branch; null for the default

condition.description: The condition's source as written, when it was found

holds.description: The condition's truth in this run; null when it was not evaluated, and for the default

taken.description: Whether this run checked this branch

default.description: The default branch, checked when no condition holds

check.description: The branch's check, when it was built (a lazy check only when its branch is taken)

source.description: The source of a check that was not built, as written

concrete.description: The name with this run's values: tb.dev.map.block.reg3.F

symbolic.description: The name with its variable parts as <expr>: tb.dev.map.block.reg<channel>.F; the same text when it has none
